subject: SOC 2 Type II report + specific control evidence (MFA, privileged access logs) for Brightwell Health
messages:
From: Julia Santos <julia.santos@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II and supporting control artifacts for procurement

Hi Mina,

We're starting Brightwell's vendor review for Q2 and need Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the 2026 audit period. In addition to the report, our compliance team has asked for specific control evidence tied to a few controls:

- MFA enforcement logs showing dates when multi-factor was enforced for all interactive accounts (slices covering Jan 2026–Mar 2027).
- Privileged access review evidence (results of last quarterly privileged access review and policy).
- Sample auth/access logs that show a typical production-day activity (timestamps, anonymized user IDs are fine).

Can you also confirm your audit period dates? Our list currently shows 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31, but procurement needs explicit confirmation and a bridge letter if the report's issuance date falls outside our contract evaluation window.

If easier, please point me to a secure location where we can download the artifacts and any NDA/DSA steps required. We have a SIG/CAIQ in progress — if you have a completed CAIQ or SIG-lite we can ingest, please include.

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Santos
Senior Information Security Manager
Brightwell Health
security@brightwellhealth.com

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Julia Santos <julia.santos@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and supporting control artifacts for procurement

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to help. Summary of what I can provide immediately:

- Attached: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026 audit period (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf).
- We can produce a sanitized log slice for MFA enforcement covering Jan 2026–Mar 2027; sample format is CSV with timestamp, event_type, user_hash, auth_result.
- Privileged access review: I'll attach the policy and redacted results from the most recent quarterly review.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a CAIQ export; I'll surface that if the procurement team prefers one file.

A few clarifying asks so we scope artifacts correctly:
1) For the MFA slice — do you need per-user daily events or an aggregated per-user summary? Detailed per-event rows are heavier to redact but possible.
2) For privileged access review, do you require reviewer signatures or is a system export with reviewer IDs sufficient?
3) For the bridge letter — we can issue a standard SOC 2 bridge letter confirming controls continue in scope between report issuance and your effective date. Do you need the bridge to cover up to a specific date?

I've looped in Marissa (compliance lead) who will prepare the access-review exports and confirm redaction approach. Expect the first batch (report + CAIQ + policy) in a secure share by EOD Monday, 2027-04-05.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
ATTACHMENTS: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (pdf)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and supporting control artifacts for procurement

Mina / Marissa — quick note on log slices and delivery approach:

- For MFA enforcement logs we'll produce a 30-day full-event slice and a derived per-user summary covering Jan 2026–Mar 2027. The 30-day slice will illustrate the event format and retention mechanics; the derived summary will cover the longer window to minimize PII exposure.
- We'll pseudonymize user IDs (sha256 hash) and remove any IP addresses. If Brightwell requires time-based slices for specific dates, we'll need their top-3 dates.
- Delivery: secure S3 link with presigned URLs or shared Drive link with restricted viewers — whichever your security team prefers.

Marissa — can you confirm privileged access review export includes: reviewer name (redacted if needed), date, list of privileged accounts reviewed, and remediation tickets (ticket IDs only)?

Ben
Enterprise Security Operations
Redwood Inference
ATTACHMENTS: access-log-sample-2026-2027.csv (csv)

---
From: Julia Santos <julia.santos@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and supporting control artifacts for procurement

Thanks Mina / Ben — that plan works. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Bridge letter: please issue a bridge to cover controls through 2027-04-30 to align with our procurement approval date.
- MFA logs: per-event rows for a 30-day slice are sufficient for our reviewers; the per-user summary for the extended period is great. If you can indicate timezone (UTC vs PST) in the CSV header, that helps.
- Privileged review: reviewer IDs and remediation ticket IDs are sufficient — no signatures required.
- Delivery: secure S3 presigned link is preferred. We will provide an AWS account identifier if you need cross-account access.

Finally, can you attach a completed CAIQ or SIG-lite? If a CAIQ export isn't ready by EOD Monday, please at least include any completed SIG questionnaire sections you have.

I'll loop procurement once we have the secure share and bridge letter. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Julia
---
